projects.title: PicTr
projects.description: PicTr is an app that helps you keep track of progress through pictures! Ever wonder how much how quickly your seedlings grows? Ever wanted to see how fast your facial hair really grows from day to day? PicTr can help you organize your photo progress and show you how things really change from hour to hour, day to day, or even month to month! Let PicTr show you how things have really changed
